title: Visual extract record (frontmatter)
description: One CONVENTION SOURCE, deep-read (spec L-2): one design system, one ARIA pattern, one platform HIG section, one deceptive-pattern type. SHAPE ONLY — whether the convention is correctly characterised is the reviewing twin's judgment, not this schema's. The record is a markdown file whose YAML frontmatter this schema governs; the component catalog and the DTCG token block live in the BODY (spec W2-Q1).

item_id.description: The frozen queue row's canonical id this record answers. The filename is record_filename(item_id) + .md, which is NOT always the id itself.

outcome.description: `skipped` is the relevance bail (L-6), the survey's SOLE cut and taken only at the front of the child. A skipped record still ships — an unread source recorded with its reason is evidence; a missing file is a gap (#20).

cause.description: `touches-no-capability` is the L-6 bail and requires confidence; uncertainty keeps the source. `corpus-unreachable` is a retrieval failure, never a finding of absence.

corpus.description: The admission rule (L-7): a named, retrievable corpus with a resolvable URL and a stated version or date. A convention with no upstream corpus is an unadmitted candidate in the search output, never an extract record.

version.description: The corpus release actually read. A bare corpus name without its version silently means something else a year later.

authority.description: L-5. Recorded, never a cut — downstream must not weigh a listicle against a W3C recommendation, and a normative source disagreeing with an opinionated one must survive into the register.

statement.description: What the convention actually requires or describes, in the corpus's own terms — not the extractor's paraphrase of why it matters.

governs.description: The component or interaction pattern the convention governs.

applicability.description: Applicability to THIS project's archetype (L-3). `applies: false` with a basis is a real result and stays in the register.

basis.description: The capability-map field or archetype fact the verdict rests on.

tokens_in_body.description: True when the BODY carries a fenced DTCG token block (spec W2-Q1). Only design-system records carry one; synthesis copies it verbatim into the register row rather than merging across systems (L-3).

i18n.description: L-10: internationalization is a FIELD on a1's records, not its own angle.

notes.description: Cross-angle leads and observations that are not this record's convention.
